title: Voluntary use by non-EU countries of the Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities (ELAN)
summary: Documents submitted to ELAN on a voluntary basis will have legal value during the transitional period
update:
Non-EU countries will have to issue the following using the Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities (ELAN), starting 17 January 2028 :

documents that support imports into the EU under tariff rate quotas referred to in Regulations 2020/761 (Annexes II–XII) and 2020/1988 (Annex II) documents required to export sheepmeat and goatmeat under tariff quotas in Regulation 2020/1988 (Art. 31) authenticity certificates related to the export of basmati rice referred to in Regulation 2023/2834 .

Authorities in non-EU countries have been able to issue documents through ELAN on a voluntary basis since July 2025. However, these documents have not had any legal value. This new Regulation will give these documents legal value for customs clearance during the transition period up to 17 January 2028.

This Regulation also slightly revises the ELAN1L-TCDOC template that sets out the information required to prove the origin, or the conformity to certain standards, of the product to be exported to the EU.
why:
As a number of non-EU countries have been successfully using ELAN on a voluntary basis, giving legal value to the documents generated will improve the efficiency of completing customs procedures.

The EU is moving towards an electronic information exchange system linking all customs authorities and other relevant bodies within and outside the EU. The new ELAN system will be connected with the EU Single Window Environment for Customs. See ELAN: Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities .
timeline: The Regulation enters into force on 5 November 2026 .
actions: Exporting countries should familiarise their competent authorities with the ELAN1L-TCDOC template, and upgrade or adapt their national electronic systems to ensure compatibility with ELAN for collecting relevant data and issuing certificates of origin ahead of the 17 January 2028 deadline. For further information on how to complete the template, see The ELAN data model .
background: For further information see AGRINFO’s October 2026 webinar: Introducing the EU’s new Electronic system for Agricultural Non-customs formalities (ELAN) (videos and presentation).

title_fr: Utilisation volontaire par les pays tiers du système électronique pour les formalités agricoles non douanières (ELAN)
summary_fr: Les documents soumis à ELAN sur une base volontaire auront une valeur juridique pendant la période de transition
